findings.title: Humanitarian Situation Report | 26 November 2026
findings.source_type: Official UN situation report citing humanitarian coordination data
findings.affected_population_system: Commercial supply and affordability: 902 trucks entered November 16–22, 799 commercial; non-essential goods comprised about 6% of commercial trucks compared with about one-third averaged October 2025–October 2026. Consumer prices remained over triple pre-October 2023 levels. Only six commercial trucks carried medicines and medical supplies. Figures are attributed to the Cash Working Group citing Gaza Chamber of Commerce, not equivalent to humanitarian offloads.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Non-essential commodities accounted for approximately six per cent of commercial trucks
